title: Inspection station
passage:
Is the inspection station ready, or do you need more time?
A. Yes, the train is late.
B. Another fifteen minutes, please.
C. There are more colors.
passageZh:
檢驗站準備好了，還是你需要更多時間？
A. 是的，火車誤點。
B. 請再給我十五分鐘。
C. 還有更多顏色。
